saved_evidence.title: Uptown Sector Development Plan, Adopted Plan, February 2009
saved_evidence.description: The adopted sector development plan for Albuquerque's Uptown area sets the land use, urban design, zoning and connectivity framework the City applies there, and it is the full plan rather than the transportation extract the archive currently holds.
saved_evidence.evidence: Born-digital PDF with a full text layer, 115 pages, 4,133,982 bytes. Opens on an acknowledgements page listing Mayor Martin J. Chávez and the nine-member Council of the day — Brad Winter as President, Debbie O'Malley as Vice President, Ken Sanchez, Isaac Benton, Michael J. Cadigan and the rest. Filed by the City as uptown_sdp_adopted_plan_2_4_09.pdf. The archived extract's own cover gives the adoption date as January 15, 2009.
saved_evidence.why_retained: It is the document the archive has been recording as held while holding something else. See corrects_a_terminal_record. Two other Uptown records are already terminal — a July 2008 working version marked superseded and the wrapper alias — so the adopted plan is the one gap in an otherwise triaged set.

cross_listings.reason: A sector development plan is the zoning instrument for its area, and this is the adopted text.
That page already carries the 13-page transportation extract of this plan; the full plan belongs beside it.

saved_evidence.caution: Adopted in 2009 and amended since. The archived transportation extract is labelled "Amended Through 2013", so this text is the plan as adopted, not as currently amended.
